args.text:

- PHL on Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments means Pellow Home Living, formerly Covey & Lark Retail. The rename took effect 16 Feb 2026, and the CRM code changed from CLR to PHL.

- Older yard reports and the Pemberline Dock export can still show Covey & Lark Retail. On 16 Feb the old export heading sent a driver to the office at door 6.

args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A quick note on the PHL label confusion:

- PHL on Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments means Pellow Home Living, formerly Covey & Lark Retail. The rename took effect 16 Feb 2026, and the CRM code changed from CLR to PHL.
- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics. The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. Check the account before filing tickets or filtering on PHL.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs the Pellow Home Living label.
- Older yard reports and the Pemberline Dock export can still show Covey & Lark Retail. On 16 Feb the old export heading sent a driver to the office at door 6.

Thanks,
Bettina
